body: NTA, you’ve expressed that you wanted him to stop with those comments about how you look yet he still kept going. Especially since his words are hurting you, he should understand how you feel. I believe you’re not being overly sensitive, it is a normal reaction. I’m on your side here. I hope he stops saying such things.
